| Hazard Symbol | Description | | :---: | :--- | | ![Radioactive substance](radioactive)
Radioactive substance | These substances emit harmful rays which may cause diseases like cancer or disable somebody. We need to be extremely cautious in handling these. Uranium, radium etc. are of this kind. | | ![Dangerous for environment](environment)
Dangerous for environment | Substances with this sign are dangerous for the environment, meaning, they harm both animals and plants. They require caution when in use. Again, they have to be gathered in a place after use. They have to be recycled as much as possible. That way, they cannot do much harm to the environment. | | ![Corrosive](corrosive)
Corrosive | These cause injury to body in contact. Inhalation of such substances may cause injury inside the body. Hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid etc. are examples of this kind. |

1. Which of the following substances is used for preserving processed food for a long time?

a. preservatives

b. vinegar

c. ethylene

d. acetylene
